responsibility: Defines the main 64-bit and biarch Linux configuration layer for the rs6000 backend. It controls whether 64-bit mode is default, validates 32/64-bit ABI and code-model combinations, manages ELFv1/ELFv2 and dot-symbol policy, selects assembler and linker specs for each ABI width, sets type layouts and TOC section handling, and provides Linux64-specific runtime, profiling, debugging, and float128 configuration used across PowerPC Linux targets.
same_name_distinction: This is the Linux64 target-configuration header, controlling 32/64-bit Linux ABI policy, assembler/linker specs, TOC handling, and ELFv1/ELFv2 behavior. Unlike linux64.opt, it implements the policy and validation logic rather than merely declaring the related switches.
